notes.title: Our new game "Esport Godfather" now has its steam page!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/045578ec87275cde8e6f2390ca747e4bf02917fa.png[/img]

Hello everyone, I am 1000water, the developer of "Variables" and "Variables 2". Our new game, "Esport Godfather," has launched its Steam page. The game is set to be released on October 20, 2023.

"Esport Godfather" is a management simulation card game centered around the theme of MOBA esports. You can click the link below to visit the Steam page of "Esport Godfather" and see what it's all about.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1278540/_/

[h3]Testing & Demo[/h3]
Due to insufficient testing in the early stages of "Variables" and "Variables 2," we encountered various issues, such as numerous bugs in "Variables" and UI problems in "Variables 2". This time, after careful consideration, we have decided to conduct public testing and offer a free demo on Steam before the game's release! We hope to receive valuable feedback and suggestions from all of you to help us improve the game!

We plan to release a free demo (testing) version of "Esport Godfather" next month! You can add it to your wishlist and follow it to receive updates and even receive an email notification upon the game's release!

Alternatively, you can join our QQ group: 1094866698. During the test period, we will collect feedback and information in the group.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/5794d8560959d2a52247577abd7d62bc43aaffaa.png[/img]
[h3]Crowdfunding Campaign[/h3]
Similar to "Variable 2," we will be launching a crowdfunding campaign on Modian. This time, we have prepared various rewards, including posters, playing cards, mouse pads, badges, fridge magnets, and more. We will also open up avenues for customization. The crowdfunding campaign will allow you to customize clubs, match commentators, in-game items and equipment, sponsors, and even heroes!

When the crowdfunding campaign begins, we will provide reminders on the "Esport Godfather" page.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/cf81e1f8001487f049c20f9b01482cbcddc35c76.png[/img]
[h3]Giveaways[/h3]
During the development and release of "Variable" and "Variable 2," our studio received tremendous support from many people. We are deeply grateful to all the friends who participated in the demo and helped us improve the game.

Therefore, when the testing and free demo period begins, we will hold giveaways on Bilibili. The prizes include physical items, custom clubs, heroes, and more!

In addition, we have something big planned! In the comments section below the giveaway video, if you follow the rules and leave your ID (in Chinese or English), we will add your ID to the pool of athlete IDs! There's a chance that you might find your ID appearing in screenshots uploaded by other players!

If you want to participate, you can follow my personal Bilibili account or our studio's Bilibili account to receive the latest updates.

my personal Bilibili：https://space.bilibili.com/2138179456
our studio's Bilibili：https://space.bilibili.com/33872237

Last but not least, thank you all for your support! We will continue to work hard and create more and better games in the future!

notes.title: Question and answer
notes.content:
1. Why didn't you make a notice?
If a year and a half ago, I made an announcement that the game could not be updated, no creator would give up his own game. If everything doesn't go well in this year and a half, Variable 2 can't be completed, it will break the promise. A year and a half ago, I can't predict what will happen in the future. Therefore, from my point of view, I can't draw cakes in the face of shadowless things.
2. Why if you have Variable then when Variable 2 is developed, the new game will be automatically entered into you Steam Library?
In the end of the Variable,it didn't achieve what I wanted to achieve. I said in the QQ group (126203854) before that, I used to hope that Variable would make me stand up and say that this is the best tower defense game in the world. But until the end, I didn't achieve it. And for a game work, if the creator himself can not be responsible for his own work, then why did it.
So the earliest plan is to make a remake version update on the original version, but in my eyes, rather than remake the original version, it is better to do the second generation of the game, then the new game will be automatically entered into you Steam Library is justified.
3. Will the new game automatically enter the Library affect the quality of the game?
When I do a game, I get a corresponding tattoo, and the Variable tattoo is on the outside of my right arm, and I'm not going to develop a game that I don't approve of myself.
4.Whether the game studio can survive by doing so?
Idealists will die on the road sooner or later, not today but tomorrow. I came out of the company, is to develop my own game, not to start a business, if today I in order to survive to betray my own ideas,anything that has a first time and a second time, there will be a third time,where should I put myself in the end? Besides, to put it bluntly, in terms of design, I believe I'm right. So I believe I won’t die because of hunger. Welcome to be the spiritual shareholders of Asteroid Studio, and don't need to worry too much about whether we can survive.

notes.title: 2019.10.24 Update
notes.content:
Hi,
In the last month, we update many new contents.
The gameplay part is finally done here, and the new ui and 3d version monsters will come soon.
Now let’s look at updates.

1.New Game Modes
Architect Mode
The map if fully covered by the ground. Gain platforms instead of grounds.

Scavenger Mode
Choose 1 from 3 while looting equipment, and equipments are not unique anymore. Select at least 2 while choosing system plugins.

Actuary Mode
Gain double money after battle, but will not gain supply draw chances anymore. Draw supply cost 25 money and the price will increase by 25 after each draw.

2. Battle Preparation Modules
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/0eb96b3e0d1f9489309cc308a7b67eb6b1dc7e64.png[/img]
At the start of the battle, you can config the craft table.
Except the blueprints, you can also select mission modules, which will grant you reward on complete.

3.New Turrets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/a8e753465fb2883ba4de55ba032996c9cb7cc3f2.png[/img]

We have 7 new turrets

T1/T2
Timespace Cube
To every non Timespace Cube turrets in the attack range, provide attack range equal to half of the Cubes' attack range and 400/1000 attack. For every tiles of blocked attack range, provide an extra of 400/1000 attack.
Timespace Cube cannot attack.

U
Reaction Catalyst
Apply 80 layers of acidburn and acidburn vulnerability to target for 10 seconds, and will not stack.
Choose target randomly.

V1/V2
Dark Matter Projector
Base attack is 0.
Increase attack by 2500/10000.

W1/W2/W3
Rock Fort
The minimum attack range is 6/8/10 tiles, and the slowest attack speed is 5/4/3 seconds.

X1/X2
Meltagun
For every times attacked, quicken attack speed by 1 second.

Y
Quantum Sling
All of the Quantum Slings share their equipment slots.
The count of slots equal to the number of Quantum slings plus 1.

Z
Revolver Cannon
Can only attack ground units.
Attack range type is semicircle.

4.New Equipment
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/4209c1cf2e8e4ceaabf1b9cc6e5c7b9b431bebe5.png[/img]
Function
If equipment count is even, increase splash range, attack range, blocked attack range by 2 tiles, crit damage by 200%, crit chance by 50%;
If equipment count is odd, the bouns is halved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/cc7f6868e9fc21de4ffb0c5f53b94887cff981f2.png[/img]
Angry Boar
Increase attack by 100% of the base. 
On attack, until the end of the battle, slow the attack speed by 1 second up 5 times and increase attack by 150% of the base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/6e1edde4f1a0a8e4fe2cdba9b82dc43d3f38a5b5.png[/img]
Red Mushroom
For every times dealt damage, increase base attack by 50.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35060301/6ead4b632676d03424c410a6da3e9d8a63ba855d.png[/img]
Rivergraph's Kindness
Slow the attack speed by 3 seconds.
For every times dealt crit damage, increase crit damage by 100% until the end of the battle.

5.New Difficulties
Difficulty 7 and 8, turrets will start with 3 equipment slots.

6.Balance
So many balance changes, only list the most important change here.
H1: blueprint change to A1+D1+F2, and the upgrade cost of H1 is reduced to 100.
K1: blueprint change to B3+D3+F1.
The 7th Totem: the effect on attack speed equal to 7 change to add 1 bullet count for every 14 seconds.

7.Unlock System Overhaul
We now have a smoother unlock line.
You will gain unlock points on finish game, and whenever the points reach an unlock threshold a equipment/system plugin/turret/mission module will be unlocked.


There may still have some bugs hidden.
You can contact us by qq group: 126203854 to improve the game.
Thanks and have a good time.

notes.title: 2019.8.2 Update
notes.content:
Increase Super Hero’s move speed in fragile mode.
Slightly adjust bosses and elites’ HP
Add many shortcut keys
Add 3 new system plugins:
Long Term Effect
Effect 1: Change supply level to max level.
Effect 2, permanent: If drawn supply this level, decrease supply level by 2 next level.

Temporary Barrel
Effect 1, 3 levels later: For first 10 seconds of the battle, increase all turrets' attack range by 3 tiles.
Effect 2, next 3 levels: For first 10 seconds of the battle, decrease all turrets' attack range by 3 tiles.

Indented Turtle
Effect 1, permanent: Change the damage and acidburn that monsters taken base on their move speed.
The factor is 1/move speed.
Effect 2, next 3 levels: Increase monsters' move speed to 1.2 times.

Auto Save is coming soon.
Have a great weekend
